Render the deterministic pull request report from a report envelope

Usage: provenance report render [OPTIONS] --input <INPUT>

Options:
      --input <INPUT>    Report envelope JSON (schema version 1)
      --quiet            Drop the advisory notes commands print alongside their output, such as the warning that this repository has no shaping skills installed
      --format <FORMAT>  [default: markdown] [possible values: json, markdown]
      --output <OUTPUT>  Write the result to this file instead of standard output
  -h, --help             Print help
